title: 17088 - 17088/P0704
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Circuit F36 short to B+ or Ground
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  wiring and connections of circuit F36
technicalNotes: Depressing the clutch pedal the voltage of F36 goes to low. If the ECU does not detect this change in voltage, the dtc is set.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
